jei.overdrive.info.overdrive: Place against any machine: the back plate faces the machine. Each step doubles the speed and quadruples the energy (100 × m² FE/t). Heat rises with the multiplier; cool it with ice blocks around it, water or Cryo Coolant in its tank. Above 70 %% it throttles, at 100 %% it melts down. Redstone mode button in the GUI; a comparator reads the heat.
jei.overdrive.info.chip: Goes into the Overdrive's chip slot and sets the maximum multiplier: T1 8×, T2 16×, T3 32×, T4 64×. Wears down while running, faster when hot. Repair it by crafting it with Thermal Paste.
jei.overdrive.info.heat_sink_upgrade: Overdrive upgrade: multiplies the cooling capacity (×1.5 by default). Two stack.
jei.overdrive.info.efficiency_upgrade: Overdrive upgrade: lowers the energy cost (×0.75 by default). Two stack.
jei.overdrive.info.overcharge_upgrade: Overdrive upgrade: doubles the chip's multiplier limit (a T3 chip reaches 64×) but produces more heat (×1.5 by default).
jei.overdrive.info.thermal_paste: Use on an Overdrive to remove 30 %% heat instantly. Craft one damaged Overclock Chip with 1-4 Thermal Paste to restore 25 %% durability per paste.
jei.overdrive.info.cryo_coolant: Fill an Overdrive's tank with it (bucket or pipe): cooling 2048 instead of water's 128, and it lasts far longer.
